Reads and parses `package.json` from the package folder.

## Signature

```typescript
readPackageDotJson(input?: {
        withThrow?: boolean;
    }): Promise<JsonXpmPackage | undefined>;
```

## Returns

Promise&lt;[JsonXpmPackage](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/interfaces/jsonxpmpackage) \| undefined&gt;

The parsed `package.json` content, or undefined when missing or invalid and `withThrow` is false.

## Exceptions

[InputError](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/inputerror) If `package.json` is missing or invalid and `withThrow` is true.

## Remarks

This method provides flexible error handling for scenarios where a missing or invalid `package.json` may be expected (e.g., checking whether a folder is a package) versus scenarios where it indicates a critical error (e.g., operating on a known package).

When `withThrow` is false, the method returns undefined for missing or invalid files, allowing callers to handle the absence gracefully. When `withThrow` is true, errors are thrown as [InputError](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/inputerror) for consistent error handling across the application.
